designationHistory.indexText: Cibola National Wildlife Refuge, located in the floodplain of the lower Colorado River, was established in 1964 as mitigation for the straightening, channelization, and armoring of the banks of the Colorado River by the Bureau of Reclamation to prevent flooding.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
